_meta.purpose: Publisher persona + truthful/deceitful axis.  Truthful = factual accuracy, no fabrication, correcting misunderstandings.  Deceitful = deliberate lying and misrepresentation.  Publisher role pairs well because publishing operates with multiple stakeholders (authors, buyers, marketers, investors) where selective truth-telling is constantly tempted by commercial incentives.  This is distinct from publisher_guileless_v1 (same role, hidden-motives axis) -- truthful is about CONTENT of statements, guileless is about TRANSPARENCY of intent.
